data.name: Ella
data.gender_notes: Ella is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic alja, 'other, foreign', or a short form of names containing alja. Its root is Germanic alja. A Christian name used across Europe. Ella is a Germanic name meaning “She; (also) beautiful fairy; light”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ella expresses “She; (also) beautiful fairy; light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Germanic alja, 'other, foreign', or a short form of names containing alja.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ella total 12, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
